title: Entering Off leaves the arbiter's mode and tank set-point at the optimizer's last write
claim: After the optimizer is set to Off, the pump-mode select stays on the last step's duty (Tuya: 'DHW (Hot Water)') and a Modbus pump's tank set-point stays on the space-step gate (40 against the configured 50), through three later cycles, where the brief's off row owes each written entity its baseline once (both circuits allowed, the configured tank set-point).
mechanism: pump_arbiter._arbitrate's MODE_OFF branch only _forget()s the record; the baseline row (desired(coord, inp, None, now)) is written by pump_arbiter.release on unload alone, and off_restore.async_mode_change restores only registered consumers (the space set-point, the heat curve, MQTT). The module docstring states 'The mode, the hot-water set-point and the silent switch are not restored' and tests/features.py pins 'switching the optimizer off writes the space set-point's baseline back, once, and nothing else', so the fix changes a pinned rule against the D16 owner ruling of 2026-11-15.

evidence.machine: box B11 (shared, up to three compute seats)
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats may share B11; the number is a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D16/s3/m6_restore.py --perturb arbiter: off_restore.async_mode_change, on the change into Off, also writes release()'s baseline row (desired(...None...) with space_setpoint=None) through pump_arbiter._command

metric_definition: Per arm and entity: 1 when the entity's state, after Off and three cycles, differs from its pre-write baseline (mode Heating + DHW, tank 50); key = state the delivered service calls left.
phenomenon_property: Every arbiter slot written under Control (mode, tank set-point, and the silent and night-mode slots) is returned to its baseline once on the change into Off, as unload's release() already does, not only the space set-point.

null_control.note: the same plant and trigger with a plan starting two hours ahead: the arbiter served its baseline row, so nothing is owed and nothing is counted

reproduction_steps: run the command; read RESULT unrestored_off__select.pump_mode and unrestored_off_modbus__number.dhw_set
proposed_fix_scope: pump_arbiter: on the transition into MODE_OFF under Control, write the baseline row's mode and tank set-point (the unload release's row, space excluded) once before forgetting the record; re-pin the features.py check that asserts Off writes nothing else.
